title: Transport Command Acknowledgement
description: Payload of a response:transport envelope. The REAPER extension sends it after executing a transport command the PWA asked for, and the Message Router forwards it to the session's PWA (Requirement 14.1). Correlation is the whole content: the PWA generated the requestId on its request:transport, holds the command it sent, and only needs to know that this particular one landed. Nothing else is reported because nothing else is knowable at the moment of acknowledgement — REAPER's transport actions do not fail in a way the extension can observe, and the resulting play state reaches both clients through the project context snapshot rather than through this reply.

requestId.description: The requestId the request:transport envelope carried, echoed so the PWA can match this acknowledgement to the command it sent. The envelope carries it as well and that is the copy the router forwards; it is repeated here so the payload identifies its own subject.
